muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿ألهاكم﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو) [Translator's note: so in the source, although it then parses ﴿التكاثر﴾ as the postponed agent], and the kāf is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿التكاثر﴾: a postponed fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit and genitive.
﴿زرتم﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿زرتم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the particle relative, which is the ﴿أن﴾ concealed after «حتى»; the interpreted maṣdar from the concealed «أن» and ﴿زرتم﴾ is genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألهاكم﴾.
﴿المقابر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿سوف﴾: a particle of the future indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the object is omitted, i.e. "you will know the evil outcome of what you are upon" (تعلمون سوء عاقبة ما أنتم عليه); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿سوف﴾: a particle of the future indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the object is omitted, i.e. "you will know the evil outcome of what you are upon" (تعلمون سوء عاقبة ما أنتم عليه); the clause is conjoined to the one before it, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لو﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the object is omitted, i.e. "if you knew the outcome of that" (لو تعلمون عاقبة ذلك).
﴿علم﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿اليقين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "rivalry in increase would not have distracted you" (ما ألهاكم التكاثر), and the conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿لترون﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and «ترون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw of the plural is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the doubled nūn is for emphasis.
﴿الجحيم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause answering the implied oath has no grammatical position, and the oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿لترونها﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and «ترون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw of the plural is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), the doubled nūn is for emphasis, and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عين﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "you will surely see it with a seeing of the eye of certainty" (لتروُنَّها رؤية عين اليقين).
﴿اليقين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the clause answering the implied oath has no grammatical position, and the oath clause is conjoined to the one before it, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿لتسألن﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and «تسألن» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, is in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the doubled nūn is for emphasis.
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لتسألن﴾, and it is muḍāf; «إذٍ» is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, implied because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿عن النعيم﴾: «عن» is a preposition, and «النعيم» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by «عن», the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿لتسألن﴾; the clause answering the implied oath has no grammatical position, and the oath clause is conjoined to the one before it, with no grammatical position.
